# challenge

Work on what follows from taking these commitments up. You see their authored commitment field without the associated body. Say when that view is insufficient; do not infer that unexposed material never existed.

## Original problem (task)
[b51acede51431703] (h005.task.v1)
Can we make sense of a person's responsibility for actions whose motives were shaped by forces that the person did not choose?

## Selected input reopen (p.challenge.0)

COMMITMENTS
Taking this up commits me to a specific and modest move: I am proposing to work through the settled-cruel-disposition case against the four parameters, and to report whether they render it without changing what they are for. I am not claiming in advance that they will fail, nor that they will succeed.

This is narrower than the prior body's description claim. The prior body claimed the four parameters describe a case's shape rather than add up to a degree. I am not re-asserting that here; I am treating it as the hypothesis the disposed case is meant to test. If the parameters render the disposed case cleanly on their original reading, the description view's contrast with the carry response weakens. If they do not, the description view gains conditional support, but only against that case.

The marker I proposed — formation versus present purchase as the relevant job of the parameters — is my own stipulation, not something the source material supplies. Someone could reject it or replace it with a different marker, in which case the test outcome may differ. I am not treating the marker as fixed.

The regress and the restatement worry remain open costs. I am not claiming to break the regress, and I am not claiming the description view is distinct from the objection until the disposed case is run. Running the case does not by itself answer either cost; it only bears on whether the description view survives in the specific form the prior body proposed.

What I am not committing to: any verdict about responsibility in the disposed case, any claim about which reading of the four parameters is correct, and any claim that this exercise settles the carry response. The carry response's case-specific reading may still be right even if the disposed case does not vindicate it, because other cases might.

## What to return
A JSON object carrying "body" and "commitments". Both are strings and nothing else is required.
